title: K-projectivity of ordinary adic quotient models
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a coefficient-universe commutative ring, J an ideal, and U an object of the coefficient pro-etale site. Assume terminal-object evaluation of every epimorphism of set sheaves on the slice is surjective. For an integer cochain complex P with finite projective A-module terms and strict bounds a,b, every ordinary quotient complex C_n(P) of def-sfb-adic-perfect-reduction-model-complexes is K-projective.

proof.text: Apply termwise projectivity of the ordinary quotient complex. Its upper bound b is preserved by each additive termwise functor, via HomologicalComplex.map_isStrictlySupported. Apply Mathlib CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective with bound b.

mathlib_searches.query: An additive functor maps a bounded above cochain complex to a bounded above cochain complex and projective terms imply K projective
mathlib_searches.results: CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective. No theorem realizing the concrete quotient terms as projectives on the coefficient slice.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the bounded-above criterion; isolate the termwise sheaf calculation.

mathlib_searches.results: isKProjective_of_projective, isKProjective_of_iso, and homotopy invariance. None gives termwise projectivity for this realization.
mathlib_searches.verdict: The general criterion is sufficient after termwise projectivity.

mathlib_searches.results: HomologicalComplex.map_isStrictlySupported preserves the bound; CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective supplies K-projectivity. Source search found sf_weakly_contractible_projective for the large pro-etale site, not the coefficient-site slice in this statement.
mathlib_searches.verdict: General ingredients exist; the concrete coefficient-slice projectivity remains.

lean.statement:
theorem adicPerfectReductionModels_kprojective (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
    (_hU : AdicResidueSliceWeaklyContractible.{u, v} X U)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A) ℤ)
    (a b : ℤ) (_ha : P.IsStrictlyGE a) (_hb : P.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (_hP : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite A (P.X i) ∧ Module.Projective A (P.X i)) :
    let R := fun n : ℕ ↦
      (finite (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J n).over U
    let C : (n : ℕ) → Cx (R n) := fun n ↦ adicPerfectQuotientComplex.{u, v} X J U P n
    ∀ n : ℕ, (C n).IsKProjective
